rendered.title: Stripe Payments - Global Payment Infrastructure
rendered.description: Accept payments online, in-person, and around the world with a payment solution built for any business.
rendered.text:
# Stripe Payments Global Infrastructure

Stripe provides online payment processing across 195 countries. Built for developers, fast-growing internet businesses, and public corporations.

## Transparent Pricing
Pricing starts at 2.9% + 30¢ per successful transaction. Volume discounts available.

## Support and Global Offices
Contact us at 24/7 support line or visit our main office in San Francisco, CA.

Designed for internet platforms and developers worldwide.
